after.title: Power Liftgate Fire Hazard
after.description: NHTSA campaign 23V338000 covers certain 2014-2016 Jeep Cherokee vehicles equipped with a power liftgate. An electrical short in the power liftgate module may cause a vehicle fire whether the ignition is on or off.
after.solution: Check VIN eligibility. Until the recall repair is complete, park outside and away from structures. Dealers relocate the power liftgate module, add a water shield, inspect for corrosion, and replace the module and electrical connectors when necessary, free of charge. Vehicles repaired under superseded campaigns 15V393 and 15V826 still require the new remedy.

after.title: Power Transfer Unit (PTU) Failure
after.description: NHTSA campaign 20V343000 covers certain 2014-2017 Jeep Cherokee vehicles equipped with a two-speed Power Transfer Unit. Relative movement between the differential input splines and transmission output shaft may wear away input-spline teeth, causing loss of drive while moving and loss of Park while stationary.
after.solution: Check VIN eligibility. Dealers perform a software update that engages rear-wheel drive to maintain propulsion and activates the electronic parking brake to prevent rollaway if an input-spline failure occurs. The campaign does not state that dealers replace the PTU.

after.title: Rearview Camera Display Failure (Recall 23V-577)
after.description: NHTSA campaign 23V577000 covers certain 2022-2024 Jeep Wagoneer and Grand Wagoneer vehicles. after.solution: Check the VIN for campaign 23V577000 (FCA recall 56A). Dealers update the Central Vision Park Assist Module software free of charge. Until repaired, physically check the area behind the vehicle before backing because the rearview image may not display.

after.title: 4xe Engine Sand-Casting Contamination — Loss of Propulsion / Engine Fire (Recall 25V-766 / 78C)
after.description: NHTSA campaign 25V766000 covers certain 2024-2025 Jeep Wrangler 4xe plug-in hybrid vehicles. Casting-sand debris inside the engine can contaminate internal components and cause catastrophic engine failure, an unexpected loss of drive power, or an engine-compartment fire. Owners may notice engine knocking or a malfunction indicator lamp before failure.
after.solution: Check the VIN for campaign 25V766000 (FCA recall 78C). Dealers install a software update and replace the engine block or engine as necessary, free of charge. Stop driving and contact a dealer if knocking, a malfunction indicator lamp, loss of propulsion, smoke, or fire occurs.

after.title: Aluminum Body Panel & Door Hinge Galvanic Corrosion (Paint Bubbling/Flaking)
after.description: Stellantis bulletin 31-002-22 applies to 2018-current JL Jeep Wrangler aluminum panels with corrosion or paint bubbling on hoods, hinges, doors, fenders, swing gates or other exterior surfaces. The bulletin warns that ferrous-metal cross-contamination during preparation can lead to galvanic corrosion.
after.solution: A qualified repair facility should inspect the aluminum panel and obtain any required authorization. Severely pitted panels may require replacement. Otherwise, the bulletin calls for removing corrosion, preparing the aluminum separately from ferrous metals, applying Mopar anti-corrosion pen 06103087AA, epoxy primer and the specified refinishing system. The cited bulletin does not direct a universal hinge replacement.
symptoms: Corrosion or paint bubbling on an aluminum exterior panel
Bubbling at a hood, hinge, door, fender or swing-gate area

after.title: Electric-Hydraulic Power Steering Pump Wiring Overheat — Fire Risk & Loss of Assist (2026 Recall)
after.description: NHTSA campaign 26V363000 covers certain 2021-2025 Jeep Wrangler, Wrangler 4xe and Gladiator vehicles. High resistance at the electric-hydraulic power steering pump electrical connection may overheat combustible material and cause a vehicle fire, including while the vehicle is parked with the ignition off. Loss of steering assist or a Service Power Steering message may occur.
after.solution: Check the VIN for campaign 26V363000 (FCA recall 21D). Until repaired, park outside and away from structures and other vehicles. Dealers inspect and repair or replace affected wiring and the electric-hydraulic power steering pump as necessary, free of charge.

after.title: Manual transmission clutch pressure plate overheating / fire risk (recall 21V-028 & 23V-116)
after.description: NHTSA campaign 23V116000 covers certain 2018-2023 Jeep Wrangler vehicles equipped with manual transmissions. The clutch intermediate pressure plate may overheat and fracture, potentially cracking the transmission case and expelling heated debris. The debris may contact an ignition source and cause a fire; clutch odor, slippage or cluster messages may occur first.
after.solution: Check the VIN for campaign 23V116000 (FCA recall 19A). Dealers replace the clutch assembly and update the software free of charge. Campaign 23V116 expands and replaces 21V028, so vehicles repaired under the earlier campaign still require the newer remedy.
